rows.jp: 冬子の家は大きい。
rows.en: Touko's house is enormous.

ghs.en: Touko's house is huge.

rows.jp: 大きすぎて陽光を遮り、一面の闇にしか見えない。
rows.en: So enormous that it blocks the sunlight and looks like nothing but a mass of darkness.

ghs.en: So enormously huge that it intercepts the sunlight, and I can't see anything besides silhouetted darkness.
ghs.assessment: The house blocks the sunlight and looks like a single expanse of darkness. 'Silhouetted darkness' is contradictory, and the English adds a claim that the narrator can see nothing else.

highlights.text: So enormously huge that it intercepts the sunlight, and I can't see anything besides silhouetted darkness.

rows.jp: 俺は夜目がきくが、なぜかまったく見えない。
rows.en: I can see well in the dark, but for some reason I can't see a thing.

ghs.en: I have sharp night eyes, but for some reason I absolutely can't see.
ghs.assessment: 夜目がきく means to see well in darkness. 'Have sharp night eyes' is a literal and unnatural compound.

highlights.text: I have sharp night eyes, but for some reason I absolutely can't see.

rows.jp: 人類が消えてしまった今、その程度の不思議現象は気にする価値もない。
rows.en: Now that humanity is gone, a minor mystery like that isn't worth worrying about.

ghs.en: In the present, where humanity has vanished, an inexplicable phenomenon of this level isn't worth paying attention to.

rows.jp: 中に入る。
rows.en: I go inside.

ghs.en: I go inside.

rows.jp: 当然のように、鎧とかが置いてある。
rows.en: Naturally, the place has suits of armor and the like standing around.

ghs.en: Naturally, there is a suit of armor inside.

rows.jp: ……のかも知れないが、窓が締め切ってあるから真っ暗だ。
rows.en: ……Or so I imagine. With all the windows shut, it is pitch-black.

ghs.en: ...or so I sort of guess, because it's pitch-black darkness due to the windows being firmly shut.

rows.jp: これではいくら夜目がきいても、視界は確保できない。
rows.en: Even my night vision is no use here.

ghs.en: With things like this, no matter how sharp my night vision, I can't be certain of what I see.
ghs.assessment: Even excellent night vision cannot secure any visibility in total darkness. The English instead says that he cannot be certain about what he does see.

highlights.text: With things like this, no matter how sharp my night vision, I can't be certain of what I see.

rows.jp: 屋敷をうろつきまわる。
rows.en: I wander through the house.

ghs.en: I wander through the residence.

rows.jp: 迷路のようだった。
rows.en: It is like a labyrinth.

ghs.en: It was like a maze.

rows.jp: 冬子の部屋はどこだろう。
rows.en: Where is Touko's room?

ghs.en: Where could Touko's room even be.

rows.jp: 二階かな。
rows.en: Upstairs, maybe.

ghs.en: Second floor maybe?

rows.jp: 階段をのぼる。
rows.en: I climb the stairs.

ghs.en: I climb the staircase.

rows.jp: なんかゾンビが出そうな屋敷だなあ。
rows.en: This is the kind of house a zombie could shamble out of.

ghs.en: This is the kind of a mansion where you'd just see some zombies popping out, isn't it.
ghs.assessment: 'The kind of a mansion' incorrectly combines the definite construction 'the kind of' with an indefinite article.

highlights.text: This is the kind of a mansion where you'd just see some zombies popping out, isn't it.

rows.jp: 「冬子ー！」
rows.en: “Touko!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "TOUKOOO!"

rows.jp: 返事はない。
rows.en: No answer.

ghs.en: No response.

rows.jp: 声は屋敷の豪奢な絨毯に、吸い取られてしまう。
rows.en: The mansion's sumptuous carpets swallow my voice.

ghs.en: The mansion's luxurious runner carpets completely absorb my voice.

rows.jp: 部屋を一つ一つ確認していく。
rows.en: I check the rooms one by one.

ghs.en: I go check the rooms one by one.

rows.jp: 面倒。
rows.en: What a pain.

ghs.en: What a pain.

rows.jp: ……曜子ちゃんについてきてもらえばよかった。
rows.en: ……I should have had Yoko come with me.

ghs.en: ...it'd have been better if I had come with Youko-chan.
ghs.assessment: Taichi wishes that he had asked Youko to come along with him. 'If I had come with Youko' reverses who would be accompanying whom.

highlights.text: ...it'd have been better if I had come with Youko-chan.

rows.jp: と、無数にある扉の一つを開くと。
rows.en: Then I open one of the countless doors.

ghs.en: So, I open one of the countless doors there.

rows.jp: 光がさしこんだ。
rows.en: Light streams in.

ghs.en: Light was shining in.

rows.jp: 窓は全開だった。
rows.en: The windows are wide open.

ghs.en: The window was wide open.

rows.jp: そっと入り込んだ風が、室内を旋回してまた出ていく。
rows.en: A gentle breeze slips in, circles the room, and passes out again.

ghs.en: The wind gently enters, makes the rounds of the room's interior, then leaves.

rows.jp: だからだろうか。
rows.en: Perhaps that is why.

ghs.en: This is probably why,

rows.jp: 腐臭さえしない。
rows.en: There is not even the smell of decay.

ghs.en: there's no smell of rot.

rows.en: “……Touko.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...Touko."

rows.jp: 触れる気がしなかった。
rows.en: I cannot bring myself to touch her.

ghs.en: I did not feel like touching her.

rows.jp: 嫌悪感ではない。
rows.en: Not out of revulsion.

ghs.en: Not because of revulsion.

rows.jp: その有様が、尊く思えたからだ。
rows.en: Because the sight seems sublime to me.

ghs.en: Because this state seemed, to me, sacred.

rows.jp: 眠り姫を思わせて、気高い。
rows.en: She reminds me of Sleeping Beauty. Noble.

ghs.en: A nobility that reminded me of Sleeping Beauty.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says that the sight evokes Sleeping Beauty and is noble. The English turns the predicate into the fragment 'A nobility.'

highlights.text: A nobility that reminded me of Sleeping Beauty.

rows.jp: 群青の冬子は一人だった。
rows.en: Touko was alone at Gunjo.

ghs.en: Touko the Ultramarine of Gunjou was alone.
ghs.assessment: 群青 is the institution or group name Gunjou in this construction. 'Touko the Ultramarine of Gunjou' translates the same name twice and invents an epithet.

highlights.text: Touko the Ultramarine of Gunjou was alone.

rows.jp: もとはお嬢様学校に通っていた。
rows.en: She had once attended an exclusive girls' school.

ghs.en: Originally, she went to a rich ladies' school.

rows.jp: 適応係数調査試験で弾かれて、ここに来た。
rows.en: The Adaptation Coefficient Test screened her out, and she ended up here.

ghs.en: Plucked off by the Conformity Coefficient Test, she came here.
ghs.assessment: The test rejected or screened Touko out. 'Plucked off' describes removal by picking and is not the social or evaluative rejection expressed here.

highlights.text: Plucked off by the Conformity Coefficient Test, she came here.

rows.jp: ……屋敷ごと。
rows.en: ……Mansion and all.

ghs.en: ...together with the mansion.

rows.jp: 適応係数は百分比で表される。
rows.en: The adaptation coefficient is expressed as a percentage.

ghs.en: The Conformity Coefficient is represented with a percentage.
ghs.assessment: A value is expressed 'as a percentage,' not 'with a percentage.'

highlights.text: The Conformity Coefficient is represented with a percentage.

rows.jp: 冬子は４６。
rows.en: Touko's was 46.

ghs.en: Touko's 46.

rows.jp: 群青では、高からず低からず。
rows.en: At Gunjo, that was neither high nor low.

ghs.en: In Gunjou, neither the highest nor the lowest.
ghs.assessment: Her value is neither high nor low within Gunjou. 'Neither the highest nor the lowest' merely denies the two extreme ranks and allows a value that is still high or low.

highlights.text: In Gunjou, neither the highest nor the lowest.

rows.jp: 乱暴なものの見方をすれば、半分は普通だったと言える。
rows.en: Crudely put, you could say she was half normal.

ghs.en: If we look at this rudely, it could be said that she's halfway normal.

rows.jp: 孤高でいる時の冬子は、誇りと屈辱にまみれて……%Nキレイだった。
rows.en: When Touko held herself aloof, she was steeped in pride and humiliation……%NAnd beautiful.

ghs.en: When she stands above all others, Touko is smeared in pride and disgrace... she was so beautiful.

rows.jp: 会話を拒絶した。教師に対しても。
rows.en: She refused to talk. Even to the teachers.

ghs.en: She refused conversation. Even with the teachers.

rows.jp: 学校に来ても制服を拒み、内にこもって人を拒み。
rows.en: She came to school but refused the uniform, retreated into herself, and rejected everyone.

ghs.en: She came to school but refused the uniform, she segregates herself inside and rejects the people.
ghs.assessment: She shut herself away and rejected people. 'Segregates herself inside' is unidiomatic, changes tense, and does not express withdrawal into herself or her room.

highlights.text: She came to school but refused the uniform, she segregates herself inside and rejects the people.

rows.jp: どこにも属さず誰にもへつらわず。
rows.en: Belonging nowhere. Fawning on no one.

ghs.en: Belonging nowhere, being nice to no one.
ghs.assessment: へつらう means to flatter, fawn, or curry favor. 'Being nice to no one' wrongly turns refusal to abase herself into a lack of ordinary kindness.

highlights.text: Belonging nowhere, being nice to no one.

rows.jp: けれど心の中は、人への渇望で揺れていた。
rows.en: And yet inside, she trembled with hunger for other people.

ghs.en: But, inside her heart, she was swaying with a longing for people.

rows.jp: だから俺は、すぐに惹かれてしまった。
rows.en: That was why I was drawn to her so quickly.

ghs.en: And that is why I was, immediately, completely, charmed.

rows.jp: そして今、冬子は寝台の上で小ぎれいに手を組んでいる。
rows.en: And now Touko lies on the bed, her hands neatly folded.

ghs.en: And now, Touko is laying on top of her bed, her hands neatly overlapped.
ghs.assessment: A person lies on a bed; 'is laying' is transitive and requires an object.

highlights.text: And now, Touko is laying on top of her bed, her hands neatly overlapped.

rows.jp: 自分でそうしたのだろうか。
rows.en: Did she arrange them herself?

ghs.en: She probably did that on her own.
ghs.assessment: The narrator wonders whether she arranged herself that way. The English turns the question into a probability assertion.

highlights.text: She probably did that on her own.

rows.jp: 眠るように去ったのだろうか。
rows.en: Did she depart as though falling asleep?

ghs.en: She probably passed as if sleeping.
ghs.assessment: The narrator wonders whether she departed as if falling asleep. The English asserts probability and uses the incomplete verb 'passed' instead of preserving the question.

highlights.text: She probably passed as if sleeping.

rows.jp: きっと、そうなのだ。
rows.en: That must be how it was.

ghs.en: I'm sure, she must have.

rows.jp: 悲劇的な結末だとは思う。一般的には。
rows.en: I do think it is a tragic end. By ordinary standards.

ghs.en: This looks like a tragic conclusion. Typically it would be.

rows.jp: けど悲しささえ圧倒的な尊厳に塗りかえられて。
rows.en: But overwhelming dignity paints over even the sorrow.

ghs.en: But even the sadness is varnished with an overwhelming sense of dignity.
ghs.assessment: Overwhelming dignity overwrites even the sadness. 'Varnished with' merely coats sadness and reverses which element transforms the other.

highlights.text: But even the sadness is varnished with an overwhelming sense of dignity.

rows.jp: 俺は感動し、佇んだ。
rows.en: Moved, I stand there before her.

ghs.en: Moved, I stand still.
ghs.assessment: The narrative reports that he was moved and stood there. The English unexpectedly switches to present tense.

highlights.text: Moved, I stand still.

rows.jp: 「……そうか」
rows.en: “……I see.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...well then."

rows.jp: 一人で去った。
rows.en: She departed alone.

ghs.en: She left us, alone.

rows.jp: あの冬子が……一人で。
rows.en: Touko, of all people…… alone.

ghs.en: Touko went... alone.

rows.jp: 「やるな……冬子」
rows.en: “Well done…… Touko.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You did it... Touko."

rows.jp: 衰弱か。薬か。餓えか。
rows.en: Debilitation? Drugs? Starvation?

ghs.en: Debilitation? Drugs? Starvation?

rows.jp: それはわからない。
rows.en: I do not know.

ghs.en: I have no idea of what.
ghs.assessment: He does not know which of the preceding causes applies. 'I have no idea of what' is incomplete and does not point back to the alternatives.

highlights.text: I have no idea of what.

rows.jp: 暴く気もない。
rows.en: Nor do I intend to pry.

ghs.en: Finding out, unthinkable.
ghs.assessment: Taichi has no intention of uncovering the cause. 'Finding out, unthinkable' changes lack of intent into a moral or conceptual impossibility.

highlights.text: Finding out, unthinkable.

rows.jp: 一つ言えること。
rows.en: There is one thing I can say.

ghs.en: There's one thing that can be said:

rows.jp: 天蓋つきの寝台に抱かれ、時を止めたように横たわる冬子の様は、夢と現実のあわいを感じさせて幻想的だった。
rows.en: Cradled in the canopied bed, Touko lies as if time itself has stopped, an otherworldly figure suspended somewhere between dream and reality.

ghs.en: Touko laying down as if time itself had stopped, embraced in this canopied bed, was a thing of fairy tale that made me feel the boundary between dream and reality.

rows.jp: 祝福を。
rows.en: Blessings.

ghs.en: I give my blessing,

rows.jp: 扉を閉める。
rows.en: I close the door.

ghs.en: and close the door.

rows.jp: 闇に一人。
rows.en: Alone in the dark.

ghs.en: Alone in the dark.

rows.jp: 屋敷を出ることにした。
rows.en: I decide to leave the house.

ghs.en: I decided to leave the mansion.

rows.jp: リセットが発生すれば、また彼女に会える。
rows.en: If the reset comes, I will be able to see her again.

ghs.en: If the reset happens, I will see her once more.

rows.jp: その事実が脳裏に呼び覚まされたのは、屋敷を出る直前だった。
rows.en: That fact comes back to me just before I step outside.

ghs.en: That fact woke up in my mind just before I left the mansion.
ghs.assessment: The fact came back to mind. It did not literally 'wake up in' his mind.

highlights.text: That fact woke up in my mind just before I left the mansion.

rows.jp: 尊さも、繰り返されれば輝きを失う。
rows.en: Even the sublime loses its radiance when repeated.

ghs.en: Even what is sacred loses its radiance if it is repeated.

rows.jp: 冬子の決意とか、寂しさとか、闘争とか。
rows.en: Touko's resolve, her loneliness, her struggle.

ghs.en: Touko's determination, Touko's loneliness, Touko's struggles, everything.

rows.jp: ……イライラした。
rows.en: ……I grow irritated.

ghs.en: ...that pissed me off.

rows.jp: 汚されたように感じた。
rows.en: I feel as though it has all been defiled.

ghs.en: It felt as if she was being dirtied.
ghs.assessment: He feels as if the sacred moment or its dignity has been defiled. The English instead says that Touko herself is being dirtied.

highlights.text: It felt as if she was being dirtied.

rows.jp: じゃあ、俺は何のために……
rows.en: Then why did I……

ghs.en: Then, for what purpose did I...

rows.jp: 冬子を突き放したのだろう。
rows.en: push Touko away?

ghs.en: To get away from Touko, that's why.
ghs.assessment: Together with the preceding line, this asks why he had pushed Touko away. The English turns the second half into the answer 'To get away from Touko, that's why.'

highlights.text: To get away from Touko, that's why.

rows.jp: 帰りの車でも、イライラは消えなかった。
rows.en: Even in the car on the way back, my irritation does not fade.

ghs.en: Even on the ride back, my irritation did not vanish.
